messages.en:
{07 16 00}I haven't put much thought
into this, {04 1f 00}, but
it's time for a change.
{07 06 00}That's right!{01 00 00 05 00} I've decided
to move to another town
for a while, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}But I'm so glad that you've
been my friend for all this
time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma pole palju mõelnud,
{04 1f 00}, aga on aeg
muutusteks.
{07 06 00}Just nii!{01 00 00 05 00} Ma otsustasin
kolida mõneks ajaks
teise linna, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Aga mul on nii hea meel, et
sa oled olnud mu sõber kogu
selle aja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Keep it between you and
me,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}but I'm thinking of
moving pretty soon.
I haven't told anyone else,
because I don't really want
anyone to worry about me.
But, {04 00 00}, I felt I
should at least tell you
about it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 08 00}Thank you for being so nice
to me, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm
going to miss you!
messages.et:
Hoia see enda teada,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}aga
ma mõtlen üsna varsti
kolimisele.
Ma pole kellelegi teisele
öelnud, sest ma ei taha, et
keegi mu pärast muretseks.
Aga, {04 00 00}, ma tundsin,
pean vähemalt sulle sellest
rääkima, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 08 00}Aitäh, et sa oled olnud
minuga nii kena, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ma hakkan sind igatsema!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I don't want to have to
explain my reasons to you,
but{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm moving.
{07 00 00}Sorry for all the trouble,
but that's just the way
things go, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}We meet people, get to
know them, and then they
get up and leave us behind.
{07 08 00}Don't cry, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I promise I won't forget
about you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei taha sulle oma
põhjuseid seletada,
aga{01 00 00 0a 00} ma kolin ära.
{07 00 00}Vabandust tüli pärast,
aga nii need asjad
käivad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Me kohtame inimesi, õpime
neid tundma ja siis nad
tõusevad ja jätavad meid.
{07 08 00}Ära nuta, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Ma luban, et ma ei unusta
sind, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 08 00}Head aega, {04 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma
ei unusta sind kunagi!

messages.en:
{07 08 00}I hope you'll be OK when I'm
gone! Promise you won't
fall to pieces without me!
messages.et:
{07 08 00}Loodan, et sul on korras,
kui ma ära lähen! Luba, et
sa ei lagune ilma minuta!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm sorry, but I've made up
my mind.{01 00 00 0f 00} I have to leave
this town while I still can!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Vabandust, aga ma olen
otsustanud.{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma pean sellest
linnast lahkuma, kuni veel saan!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Well,{01 00 00 05 00} there's nothing to be
done about it now.

{07 16 00}I'm leaving,{01 00 00 05 00} and there's no
changing my mind.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Noh,{01 00 00 05 00} sellega pole enam
midagi teha.

{07 16 00}Ma lähen{01 00 00 05 00} ja ma ei muuda
oma meelt.

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I don't want to say much,
but there's a bit of a
family crisis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}So don't make any fuss,
and I'll just leave quietly.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ma ei taha palju rääkida,
aga meil on pisut
perekriis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Nii et ära tee kära
ja ma lahkun vaikselt.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} You sound so sad!
I don't know what to do
anymore, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0e 00}What should I do?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 16 00}Should I
just forget about the
whole thing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Oh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Sa kõlad nii kurvalt!
Ma ei tea enam, mida
teha, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0e 00}Mida ma peaksin?{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 16 00} Kas
ma peaksin kogu asja
lihtsalt unustama,{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Please, don't{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.


{07 16 00}You're making this harder
than it has to be! Stop
making your sad face!
{07 0e 00}Maybe I should stay after
all{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Palun, ära{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.


{07 16 00}Sa teed selle raskemaks,
kui vaja! Lõpeta oma kurva
näo tegemine!
{07 0e 00}Ehk peaksin ma siiski
jääma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
